llm.framework: google-genai (Python SDK chinh thuc hien tai, thay cho google-generativeai da bi deprecated)
llm.note: LLM chi sinh doan dien giai ngon ngu tu nhien, log vao trace.jsonl. Toan bo so lieu/quyet dinh nghiep vu (join du lieu, delivery variance, payment reconciliation, ap dung EC_POLICY_V2, verify schema) la code Python thuan (pandas + rule engine), khong phu thuoc do chinh xac cua model 9B.

framework.orchestration: Python thuan (khong dung LangGraph/CrewAI) - ThreadPoolExecutor cho case-level parallel fan-out, ham thuan cho intra-case DAG

architecture_summary.pattern: Case-level parallel fan-out + intra-case DAG (Customer/Order&Product song song -> Router theo order_status -> Payment/Delivery -> Policy -> Verifier) + Evaluator-Optimizer (Verifier auto-trim va re-check truoc khi ghi file)

dataset.source: Kaggle - Brazilian E-Commerce Public Dataset by Olist

run_result.note: 50/50 case pass Verifier (toan bo logic nghiep vu - join du lieu, delivery variance, payment reconciliation, policy rule - da duoc kiem chung day du). Phan LLM (Gemma-2-9B-It qua google-genai SDK) da chay toi dung tang mang that nhung bi proxy cua sandbox phat trien chan (403, khong lien quan toi key hay code - xem architecture.md muc 7). Chay lai 'python main.py --workers 5' tren may co mang that (khong bi chan generativelanguage.googleapis.com) de co du trace.llm_call voi output that tu Gemma-2-9B-It.
